name: How do I choose the right contractor for mobile home repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for mobile home repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a licensed contractor who understands manufactured home structural quirks and offers hands-on oversight. Mobile homes feature lighter framing, distinct electrical routing, and non-standard stud spacing, such as 16 inches or 24 inches on center with 2x2 or 2x3 lumber. A contractor experienced in standard residential drywall alone might overlook these framing differences. Choosing a BBB Accredited contractor like HH Remodeling ensures you work with a skilled tradesperson—Abraham Becerra oversees finish carpentry, drywall, and painting on-site, coordinating trades smoothly without unnecessary delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a contractor with hands-on experience in manufactured home framing and drywall repair. Verify licensing, BBB accreditation, and clear communication regarding on-site supervision.
